Definition
[maximal function]

Source: petersen:page-0302 For $u:M\to \mathbb {R}$ and $D>0$, the maximal function of $u$ (relative to the scale $D$) is \[ M(u)(x)=\sup _{R\in (0,D]}\frac{1}{\vol B(x,R)}\int _{B(x,R)}|u|\, \vol . \]
